title: Geometric module evaluation is invariant under algebraically closed extension
statement: Let ell be prime, K and Kprime algebraically closed fields in the same universe, and i: K -> Kprime a unital ring homomorphism. For the explicit module evaluation functors fieldFiber of [def-weil-pbc-condensed-qbar-coefficient-construction], there is a natural isomorphism fieldFiber(K) ~= condensed inverse image along Spec(i) followed by fieldFiber(Kprime), as functors on all internal modules over the condensed algebraic-closure coefficient ring. The isomorphism is linear over the fixed coefficient field. Arbitrary, including transcendental, field embeddings are allowed.
